description: Source code implementing ASN.1 GeneralizedTime handling functions for OpenSSL, including conversion, setting, and adjustment of time values.

methods.name: asn1_generalizedtime_to_tm
methods.description: Converts ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME to struct tm if type matches.

methods.name: ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME_check
methods.description: Checks if ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME is valid by attempting conversion.

methods.name: ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME_set_string
methods.description: Sets ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME from a string representation.

methods.name: ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME_set
methods.description: Creates ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME from a POSIX timestamp.

methods.name: ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME_adj
methods.description: Adjusts ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME based on POSIX time and offsets.
